descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: cross-patient / cross-context navigation.

Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S15 Cross-patient and cross-context: each chart lists only its own transcripts, and the next chart opens collapsed

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Expanding a collapsed entry shows the correct full transcript: that visit's lines for that patient, all of them, and nothing from another entry. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 AC 4; TFA-92594 How it works 4)
  • U5 The expanded transcript is correctly attributed: each line shows the right speaker (Physician / Patient), and the transcript sits under the right patient and visit. (UAT TC-16)
  • U8 Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, and passes in both. (UAT 3.3; TFA-92594 AC 2)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given {hospitalPatient} with the S05 seed, {hospitalPatient2} with one '(prior)' row of its own, {snfResident} with the S06 seed

When Open patient A's '(prior)' row; go back to the list and open patient B; open B's row; switch to Nursing Home and open the resident; open the later visit

Then A shows only A's lines. B arrives collapsed (A's open state not carried over) and shows only B's lines. The resident shows only the resident's visits

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs. cp1 mustContain QA16-H-Y1 and mustNotContain 'QA16-H2-', 'QA16-N-'. cp2 (B arrive) mustContain {hospitalPatient2}, '(prior)' and mustNotContain 'QA16-H-', 'QA16-H2-Y1'. cp3 mustContain QA16-H2-Y1, QA16-H2-Y2 and mustNotContain 'QA16-H-'. cp4 mustContain QA16-N-V2 and mustNotContain 'QA16-H-', 'QA16-H2-' (U4, U5, U8)

Where it ran: dev unit U20; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S15 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-16.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 8b4be94 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-19T17:04:37Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.

UAT item: TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-16/S15

Cross-patient and cross-context: each chart lists only its own transcripts, and the next chart opens collapsed

Tickets: TFA-92594 Prior Encounter Transcripts (ready for qa)

Result: Pass from scripts/oracle.mjs on the saved evidence (units/U20.verdict.json), unit U20 split by its parts' checkpoints. Agent: 87 turns, 316 s, $0.55.

Plan: unit U20 (#20, ready-for-qa, ui-only) — Prior transcripts: collapse state and cross-patient. S13's seed (Ana, Vera) is part of S15's (Ana, Ben, Vera) with the same fields; both only open and close rows. Runs together with TC-16/S13.

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #20, U20; checked: yes): Pass — rows stay collapsed and listed across retap/tab switch/reload; each chart only its own transcripts, both contexts. Observation (perf, needs a human): chart reload on dev showed 'Loading…' ~60 s (U11: two 30 s waits)
